# langsmith_dashboard (Resource)

Manages a LangSmith dashboard: its charts, text blocks and layout. The whole dashboard is written in one request, so an apply never leaves it half updated.

Charts are identified by `key`. Changing a chart's other attributes updates it in place; removing a chart deletes it. To manage a dashboard exported from the UI as JSON, use `langsmith_dashboard_json`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_project" "api" {
  name = "my-api"
}

resource "langsmith_dashboard" "service_health" {
  title       = "Service health"
  description = "Managed by Terraform"

  charts = [
    {
      key   = "requests"
      type  = "line"
      title = "Requests"
      series = [{
        name        = "root runs"
        metric      = { type = "count" }
        project_ids = [data.langsmith_project.api.id]
        run_filter  = "eq(is_root, true)"
      }]
    },
    {
      key   = "latency"
      type  = "line"
      title = "p99 latency"
      series = [{
        name        = "p99"
        metric      = { type = "percentile", field = "latency_seconds", percentile = 0.99 }
        project_ids = [data.langsmith_project.api.id]
        group_by    = [{ attribute = "metadata", path = "env" }]
      }]
    },
    {
      key   = "error_rate"
      type  = "kpi"
      title = "Error rate"
      series = [{
        name = "errors / runs"
        metric = {
          type        = "ratio"
          numerator   = { type = "count", filter = "eq(status, \"error\")" }
          denominator = { type = "count" }
        }
        project_ids   = [data.langsmith_project.api.id]
        metadata_json = jsonencode({ value_format = "percent" })
      }]
    },
    {
      key      = "runbook"
      type     = "text"
      markdown = "Paged? See the [runbook](https://example.com/runbook)."
    },
  ]

  # Charts share a row evenly unless every chart in the row sets width_units
  # (out of 120). Charts left out of the layout are placed after it.
  layout = [
    { height_units = 4, charts = [{ key = "requests" }, { key = "latency" }] },
    { height_units = 3, charts = [{ key = "error_rate", width_units = 40 }, { key = "runbook", width_units = 80 }] },
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `title` (String) Dashboard title.

### Optional

- `charts` (Attributes List) Charts and text blocks, in display order. Charts not placed by `layout` are shown after it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--charts))
- `description` (String) Dashboard description.
- `layout` (Attributes List) Rows of charts for wide screens, top to bottom. On narrow screens each chart gets its own full-width row, in the same order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--layout))
- `workspace_id` (String) LangSmith workspace (tenant) ID that owns this dashboard. When unset, the resource uses the workspace configured on the provider block.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Dashboard ID.

<a id="nestedatt--charts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `charts`

Required:

- `key` (String) Identifies the chart within the dashboard and in `layout`. Up to 64 letters, digits, `_`, `.` or `-`, starting with a letter or digit.
- `type` (String) Chart type: `line`, `bar`, `table`, `kpi`, `top-k`, `pie`, or `text` for a Markdown text block.

Optional:

- `description` (String) Chart description. Not used by text blocks.
- `markdown` (String) Markdown content. Required for text blocks; not used by charts.
- `metadata_json` (String) Display settings the LangSmith UI stores on the chart, as a JSON object.
- `series` (Attributes List) The chart's series. Charts need between one and three; text blocks have none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--charts--series))
- `title` (String) Chart title. Required for charts; not used by text blocks.

<a id="nestedatt--charts--series"></a>
### Nested Schema for `charts.series`

Required:

- `metric` (Attributes) What the series measures. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--charts--series--metric))
- `name` (String) Series name, shown in the legend.

Optional:

- `dataset_ids` (List of String) Dataset IDs to chart experiment runs from. Set this or `project_ids`.
- `group_by` (Attributes List) Splits the series into one line per group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--charts--series--group_by))
- `metadata_json` (String) Display settings the LangSmith UI stores on the series, such as `value_format`, as a JSON object.
- `project_ids` (List of String) Tracing project IDs to chart runs from. Set this or `dataset_ids`. Look projects up with the `langsmith_project` data source.
- `run_filter` (String) Filter on runs. Only with `project_ids`.
- `trace_filter` (String) Filter on the root run of each run's trace. Only with `project_ids`.
- `tree_filter` (String) Filter on any run in each run's trace. Only with `project_ids`.

<a id="nestedatt--charts--series--metric"></a>
### Nested Schema for `charts.series.metric`

Required:

- `type` (String) Aggregation: `count`, `sum`, `max`, `min`, `avg`, `percentile` or `ratio`.

Optional:

- `denominator` (Attributes) The ratio's denominator. Required when `type` is `ratio`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--charts--series--metric--denominator))
- `feedback_key` (String) Feedback key. With `type = "count"` it counts feedback with this key; with `field = "feedback_score"` it selects which scores to aggregate.
- `field` (String) Run field to aggregate, such as `latency_seconds`, `total_tokens`, `total_cost` or `feedback_score`. Required for every type except `count` and `ratio`.
- `filter` (String) Filter, in LangSmith's filter query language, applied to the rows being aggregated.
- `numerator` (Attributes) The ratio's numerator. Required when `type` is `ratio`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--charts--series--metric--numerator))
- `percentile` (Number) Percentile between 0 and 1, such as `0.99`. Required when `type` is `percentile`.

<a id="nestedatt--charts--series--metric--denominator"></a>
### Nested Schema for `charts.series.metric.denominator`

Required:

- `type` (String) Aggregation: `count`, `sum`, `max`, `min`, `avg` or `percentile`.

Optional:

- `feedback_key` (String) Feedback key. With `type = "count"` it counts feedback with this key; with `field = "feedback_score"` it selects which scores to aggregate.
- `field` (String) Run field to aggregate, such as `latency_seconds`, `total_tokens`, `total_cost` or `feedback_score`. Required for every type except `count` and `ratio`.
- `filter` (String) Filter, in LangSmith's filter query language, applied to the rows being aggregated.
- `percentile` (Number) Percentile between 0 and 1, such as `0.99`. Required when `type` is `percentile`.


<a id="nestedatt--charts--series--metric--numerator"></a>
### Nested Schema for `charts.series.metric.numerator`

Required:

- `type` (String) Aggregation: `count`, `sum`, `max`, `min`, `avg` or `percentile`.

Optional:

- `feedback_key` (String) Feedback key. With `type = "count"` it counts feedback with this key; with `field = "feedback_score"` it selects which scores to aggregate.
- `field` (String) Run field to aggregate, such as `latency_seconds`, `total_tokens`, `total_cost` or `feedback_score`. Required for every type except `count` and `ratio`.
- `filter` (String) Filter, in LangSmith's filter query language, applied to the rows being aggregated.
- `percentile` (Number) Percentile between 0 and 1, such as `0.99`. Required when `type` is `percentile`.



<a id="nestedatt--charts--series--group_by"></a>
### Nested Schema for `charts.series.group_by`

Required:

- `attribute` (String) Attribute to group by: `name`, `run_type`, `tag`, `project`, `status`, `metadata` or `feedback_label`.

Optional:

- `path` (String) Metadata key or feedback key. Required for `metadata` and `feedback_label`.




<a id="nestedatt--layout"></a>
### Nested Schema for `layout`

Required:

- `charts` (Attributes List) Charts in the row, left to right. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--layout--charts))
- `height_units` (Number) Row height, in grid units.

<a id="nestedatt--layout--charts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `layout.charts`

Required:

- `key` (String) Key of a chart in `charts`.

Optional:

- `width_units` (Number) Width out of 120 units, at least 20. Set it on every chart in the row, totalling 120, or on none to share the row evenly.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a dashboard by its ID, from the dashboard's URL in LangSmith.
terraform import langsmith_dashboard.service_health 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
